authority: MV-IA-F006/F007 authoritative Action and Ability/rules resolution
global_invariants: Authorize and filter before hidden settings, locations, routes, factions, history, secrets, counts, map labels, summaries, exports, diagnostics, notifications, pathfinding or AI context are serialized or aggregated.

The verified 14-layer World/Setting identity-state model remains explicit from reusable Definition through cosmology, typed hierarchy, environments, infrastructure, factions, culture/economy, history, world-local content/rules, routes, Campaign state, visibility and provenance/recovery.
Reusable Setting Definitions never collapse into Campaign/Scene instantiation or current Campaign state; PPIA-08 owns Campaign/Scene authoring and live Campaign-local mutation.

Hierarchy, membership, route, chronology and compatibility require explicit source evidence or governed authoring provenance; co-occurrence, same document, name similarity, theme, proximity and AI inference are insufficient.

The verified source inventory remains 22 primary setting/cosmology/location PDFs / 693 pages, 8 reusable environment-template PDFs / 238 pages, and 2 authoring-guidance PDFs / 30 pages: 32 retained PDFs / 961 pages total, with no dedicated World/Setting CSV catalog.
Environment templates are reusable evidence only and never instantiate a named World, Region or Location without explicit attachment/source evidence.

World-local Species, Creatures/NPCs, Items, Vehicles, Abilities and rules remain setting-scoped extensions; PPIA-02/03/04/05 and owning Ability/rules domains retain their core Definitions and mechanics.
Setting-local mechanics remain local absent separate promotion authority; Musical Reality, branch-specific gameplay and unusual local physics are not universalized by appearance in a setting source.

Unknown geography, population, parentage, chronology, connectivity, compatibility or mechanics remains unknown; Stratebrait-style revision/conflict state remains separately attributable until governed resolution.
Random tables, Worldbuilding guidance, templates and AI-assisted suggestions create authoring proposals only until explicit governed acceptance through the specific owning workflow.

Accepted Setting Definition, hierarchy, environment, infrastructure, faction, culture/economy, history, content-extension, local-rule, route, Campaign-handoff and reveal mutations are server-authoritative, expected-version checked and recoverable through operation ID/status and idempotency.
Every workflow has keyboard, touch, high-zoom/reflow and screen-reader-equivalent operation; map geometry, color, node placement, drag, hover and animation are never required.

handoff_contracts.rule: F002 owns generic browse/inspect/select surfaces; it cannot infer hidden hierarchy, mutate setting truth or promote proposals.
PPIA-08 owns Campaign/Scene instantiation and live Campaign state; PPIA-12 reusable Definitions remain unchanged.
PPIA-02 retains core Creature/NPC Definition and mechanics; PPIA-12 stores only setting-scoped extension metadata.
PPIA-03 retains core Item/Asset Definition and inventory semantics; PPIA-12 does not fork universal Item mechanics.
PPIA-04 retains Vehicle/Mecha/Starship Definition and runtime semantics; PPIA-12 only scopes setting relations/extensions.
PPIA-05 retains Species/Form biology; PPIA-12 culture/society/economy and world availability never become immutable biology automatically.
PPIA-12 scopes local applicability; owning Ability/rules workflows retain mechanics, Action execution and universal promotion authority.
PPIA-11 owns encounter/balance calibration and cannot rewrite reusable setting or object Definitions.
Authorization/filtering and ambiguous-operation recovery occur before counts, maps, pathfinding, exports, notifications and AI context.
Maps, node placement, color, drag, hover and animation are supplemental; every required workflow remains operable nonvisually.

not_allowed_here: Rewrite raw PDF/CSV source or silently reconcile contradictory/revision-heavy retained source.
Invent a hierarchy, membership, route, chronology or compatibility relation from co-occurrence, same document, name similarity, theme, proximity, map appearance, AI inference or random-table output.
Instantiate a reusable environment template into a named setting without explicit source-backed attachment or governed authoring acceptance.
Universalize world-local or branch-local mechanics, Species, Creatures/NPCs, Items, Vehicles, Abilities or rules merely because they occur in a retained setting source.
Replace PPIA-02 Creature/NPC, PPIA-03 Item/Inventory, PPIA-04 Vehicle/Mecha/Starship, PPIA-05 Species/Biology, MV-IA-F006/F007 Ability/Action, or PPIA-11 balance ownership with PPIA-12 copies.

Mutate PPIA-08 Campaign/Scene current state as though it were reusable Setting Definition truth, or rewrite reusable Definitions as a side effect of Campaign destruction, occupation, discovery, rename or Scene state.
Treat Worldbuilding.PDF, World Creation tables.PDF, templates or AI-generated content as canonical merely because generated.
Hide unknown/conflict/source-absence by defaulting missing values, or silently choose a winner in Stratebrait-style revision conflicts.
Aggregate/search/count/map/pathfind/export/notify or provide AI context from hidden setting facts before MV-IA-F020/F021 authorization filtering.
Require map geometry, color, drag, hover, animation or visual node placement for any authoritative or required workflow; MV-IA-F022 nonvisual operation is mandatory.
Implement application runtime, activate STAGE-A-A2, release/deploy, expose tester access, use paid services/production credentials, or promote unsupported source material to canon.

completion_invariants: 16 PPIA-12 workflows are defined end-to-end across reference, authoring, Campaign handoff, privacy, provenance and recovery.
12 authoritative mutation workflows preserve expected-version/revalidation and operation ID/idempotency recovery.
10 cross-domain handoffs preserve PPIA-08, PPIA-02, PPIA-03, PPIA-04, PPIA-05, Ability/rules, PPIA-11, F002, F020/F021 and F022 ownership.
All 20 PPIA-12 reference cases are explicitly covered by one or more workflows.
All 16 verified Inspector action contracts are routed through the workflow layer without new action IDs.
The verified 14-layer World/Setting identity-state model and 32 retained PDFs / 961 pages source boundary are preserved.
Explicit-evidence-only hierarchy/route/chronology, environment-template separation and world-local non-universalization remain mandatory.
Definition-versus-Campaign-state separation, permission-before-aggregation/pathfinding and Stratebrait-style conflict preservation remain mandatory.
Accessible nonvisual workflow operation, source/proposal provenance, unknown-state preservation and no STAGE-A-A2/runtime/release activation remain mandatory.
